# pushward_org_tag (Resource)

A device tag. Routing rules and sending keys reach devices by tag; which devices carry it is set in the PushWard console or app, not here.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Which devices carry the tag is set in the console or the app.
resource "pushward_org_tag" "pager" {
  name        = "pager"
  description = "Phones on the on-call rota"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique in the organization: 1-40 lowercase letters, digits, `-` and `_`.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Up to 200 characters.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import pushward_org_tag.pager 9a7d3c21-4e5f-4b8a-b2c1-6d0e9f8a7b35
```
